title.narrative: Protéger les moyens de subsistance agro-pastoraux des ménages les plus vulnérables, en anticipant sur les sécheresses.

description.narrative: The main aim of this $2.5m FAO project is to protect the livelihoods of communities affected by drought. To that end, FAO will distribute drought-resistant seeds to 42,000 people, provide feed, veterinary inputs and advice on strategic destocking to 63,000 people and cash to 7,500 pastoralists. In total, FAO will target 105,000 people, including 15,700 women and 36,900 girls. Among those targeted FAO expects to 4,340 people with disabilities.
